children: According to Sina Finance, Russian presidential press secretary Dmitry Peskov said Russia is open to dialogue with all countries on ensuring Black Sea security, but has not yet held bilateral talks with any country on the issue. He made the remarks in response to whether Russia was considering bilateral agreements on Black Sea security with India, Egypt, Turkey, and others.

title: Russia Says No Bilateral Talks Have Been Held on Black Sea Security
